==Biography==
Mykolas is from Klaipeda, Lithuania. He is a versatile player, playing as an AD Carry and AP Midlaner until Season 3.

== Trivia ==
* Has trained a lot of sports, including Football and Parkour for 2 years each, and Basketball and Skateboarding for 5 years each.
* His nickname is derived from the word Inspirational.
